articles.summary: DUNMORE, Pa., Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - The Board of Directors of Fidelity D D Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: FDBC), parent company of The Fidelity Deposit and Discount Bank, announce their declaration of the Company’s fourth quarter dividend of $0.46 per share, a 7% increase above the previous quarterly cash dividend of $0.43 per share. “On behalf of the Board of Directors and all Fidelity Bankers, I am proud to announce an increase in our fourth-quarter cash dividend, marking our twelfth consecutive year of dividend growth. Over this 12-year period, our cash dividend has increased by 140%, underscoring the strength and consistency of our financial performance and our long-standing commitment to delivering sustainable value to our shareholders,” shared Daniel J. Santaniello, President and Chief Executive Officer. “This record reflects disciplined capital management, thoughtful reinvestment in our franchise, and consistent execution of our long-term strategy. articles.summary: SCRANTON, Pa., Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Fidelity D D Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: FDBC) and its banking subsidiary, Fidelity Bank, announced its unaudited, consolidated financial results for the three and nine-month periods ended September 30, 2026. Unaudited Financial Information Net income for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 was $8.9 million, or $1.53 per diluted share, compared to $7.3 million, or $1.27 per diluted share, for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. The $1.6 million, or 21%, increase in net income resulted primarily from a $3.4 million increase in net interest income coupled with a $1.0 million increase in non-interest income. This was partially offset by a $1.5 million increase in non-interest expense and a $0.9 million increase in the provision for credit losses on loans due to the growth of loans.
